record.question: State whether the following statements are True or False: (a) Permanent travelling allowance can be drawn during earned leave. (b) A journey on transfer is held to begin or end at the actual residence of the Government servant. (c) A mileage allowance shall always be calculated on the actual cost of travelling. (d) The period of enforced halt on tour cannot be treated as duty. (e) 70% of daily allowance rate can be admissible for tour exceeding six hours but not exceeding twelve hours. (f) Daily allowance may not be drawn for travel which does not reach beyond the radius of eight kilometres from the duty point. (g) Daily allowance is admissible for a continuous halt up to a maximum of 180 days. (h) Officers of Group 'D' service may be allowed reimbursement of conveyance hire charge. (i) Travelling allowance is admissible to any person for the journey to join his first post in Government service. (j) Travelling allowance is generally admissible to a Government servant for transfer at his own request.
options: True or False for each statement
